_comment: CROSS-BOUNDARY CONTRACT — the Robertson soil-behaviour-type bands keyed on Ic.
This file is the single arbiter both sides check themselves against. It exists
because a 'parity' test that compared the renderer's band table with a renderer
function that iterates the same table could never go red, while the drift that
actually happened was renderer<->backend: the chart labelled every band one step
too coarse and the backend's classify_soil_ic carried the same shift (audit
Changing a breakpoint or a label means changing it HERE first and watching both
suites go red. Zone 1 (sensitive fine-grained) is deliberately absent: it is read
off the Qtn-Fr chart, not off Ic, so no Ic band may be labelled 'Sensitive'.
ic_max of the last band is null = unbounded above (Ic has no ceiling; the chart
axis stops at 4 for drawing only).

bands.backend_label: Sands: clean sand to silty sand
Sand mixtures: silty sand to sandy silt
Silt mixtures: clayey silt to silty clay
